name: Product Carousel Slider Biddut Block
author: Shahriar Ahmed Biddut

sections.description:
Beautiful, responsive Product Carousel Slider Block with responsive columns, hover effects, gallery navigation, and add to cart functionality.

Design Variants

  • Card Style – Modern card-based layout with borders and hover effects
  • Gallery (Default) – Minimalist gallery style perfect for art and premium products

Key Features

  • Fully Responsive Columns – Independent column control for Desktop, Tablet, Mobile, and Phone
  • Header Support – Add section title and subtitle with single toggle
  • Carousel Settings – Autoplay, loop, adjustable speed
  • Disable Slider in Mobile – Show Vertically all products in mobile
  • Sale/Sold Out Label – Shows Sale based on Sale Price and Sold Out based on out of stock
  • Navigation Options – Arrows (shown on hover), dots, or both
  • Hover Effects – Zoom, lift, glow, or none
  • Gallery Features – Image dots, gallery on hover
  • Add to Cart – Show/hide add to cart button with customizable text and styling
  • Product Query – Multiple categories, custom ordering
  • Display Controls – Show/hide any element , Full Controll
  • Responsive Typography – All text sizes adjust automatically
  • Customizations – Almost Every option has Customizations
  • Optimized Performance – Clean code, minimal dependencies

Responsive Design

Set different column counts for each device:
* Desktop (1280px+): 1-6 columns
* Tablet (768-1279px): 1-4 columns
* Mobile (480-767px): 1-3 columns
* Phone (<480px): 1-2 columns

Image Display Modes

  • Natural – Maintains original aspect ratios
  • Uniform – All images same height

Perfect For

  • Online stores
  • Art galleries
  • Photography portfolios
  • Product showcases
  • E-commerce websites

Additional Info

Browser Support

  • Chrome (latest)
  • Firefox (latest)
  • Safari (latest)
  • Edge (latest)
  • Mobile browsers

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • WooCommerce 5.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • Modern browser with JavaScript enabled

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or store any user data. It only displays WooCommerce products in a carousel format.

Support

For support, please visit:
* GitHub Repository
* WordPress Support Forum

Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Visit our GitHub repository to contribute.

Credits

  • Built with WordPress & WooCommerce
  • Follows WordPress coding standards
  • Dash icons for navigation
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/product-carousel-slider-biddut-block/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. Use the Gutenberg block to add carousels to your pages
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for the plugin to work.

Can I use multiple carousels on one page?

Yes, you can add as many carousels as you need on a single page.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive with independent column control for each device size.

Does it support touch/swipe on mobile?

Yes, the carousel supports touch gestures for mobile devices.

Can I customize the colors and styling?

The plugin includes two design variants and three add-to-cart button styles. You can add custom CSS for further customization.

How do I select multiple categories?

Enter category slugs separated by commas in the Product Query settings (e.g., “featured, new-arrivals”).

Why don’t the navigation arrows show all the time?

For a cleaner look, navigation arrows appear only when you hover over the carousel. This is an intentional design choice that can be customized with CSS if needed.

Can I show products from specific categories?

Yes, you can select multiple categories by entering their slugs separated by commas.

How do I customize the Add to Cart button?

In the block settings, enable “Show Add to Cart” and choose from Default, Primary, or Outline styles. You can also customize the button text.

Where is the documentation?

Full documentation is available in WordPress Plugin Details.

  • WordPress Dashicons based navigation arrows (shown on hover)
  • Multiple carousel settings: autoplay, loop, speed
  • Gallery features: image dots, hover effects
  • Multiple category selection support
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatibility
